To:   Councillor McRae, Chairperson; and Councillors Cooke and van Sweeden.
                                                    Town House,
                                              ABERDEEN 04 August 2026
     LOCAL REVIEW BODY OF ABERDEEN CITY COUNCIL
      The Members of the LOCAL REVIEW BODY OF ABERDEEN CITY COUNCIL are
requested to meet remotely on MONDAY, 10 AUGUST 2026 at 11.00 am.
                                                            JENNI LAWSON
                                             CHIEF OFFICER – GOVERNANCE
Members of the Public can observe the meeting via Microsoft Teams here.
                               B U S I N E S S
     1.1    Procedure Notice (Pages 5 - 10)
     COPIES OF THE RELEVANT PLANS / DRAWINGS ARE AVAILABLE FOR
     INSPECTION IN ADVANCE OF THE MEETING AND WILL BE DISPLAYED AT
     THE MEETING
     Link to the Local Development Plan
     TO REVIEW THE DECISION OF THE APPOINTED OFFICER TO REFUSE THE
     FIRST APPLICATION AND FOR THE NON DETERMINATION OF THE SECOND
     APPLICATION
     PLANNING ADVISER - LUCY GREENE
     REVIEW ONE
     2.1    Detailed Planning Permission for the change of use of flat to short-term let
            accommodation with maximum occupancy of 2 people - 21B Springbank
            Street Aberdeen - presentation to follow
        Members, please note that all plans and supporting documents relevant to
        the review can be viewed online here and by entering the application
        reference number 260453.
2.2     Delegated Report, Original Application Form, Decision Notice and Letters of
        Representation (Pages 11 - 48)
2.3     Notice of Review with Supporting Information Submitted by Applicant / Agent
        (Pages 49 - 64)
2.4     Determination - Reasons for Decision
        Members, please note that reasons should be based against Development
        Plan policies and any other material considerations.
2.5     Consideration of Conditions to be Attached to the Application - if Members
        are Minded to Over-Turn the Decision of the Case Officer
REVIEW TWO
3.1     Non Determination of application for Detailed Planning Permission for the
        erection of dwelling house and sub-division of feu - land To The East Of
        Birchwood, 1 South Avenue, Aberdeen (Pages 65 - 108)
        Members, please note that all plans and supporting documents relevant to
        the review can be viewed online here and by entering the application
        reference number 251386.
3.2     Draft Delegated Report, Original Application Form and Consultee
        Comments (Pages 109 - 172)
3.3     Notice of Review with Supporting Information Submitted by Applicant / Agent
        and also responses by applicant/agent (Pages 173 - 250)
3.4     Letters of Support (Pages 251 - 344)
3.5     Letters of Objection (Pages 345 - 400)
3.6     Representations to the LRB (Pages 401 - 420)
3.7     Letters from Representations additional comments (Pages 421 - 470)
3.8     Draft report responses
